title: Graveyard/cemetery
content: I was in the GATE program in the 90s. Since I can remember I have reoccurring dreams of this cemetery. It’s on a hill. I always start at the bottom. It’s incredibly crowded with crypts and stones. I can read them while I’m in the dream but forget them when I’m awake. Sometimes I am forced to look in the crypts and there are people there. Sometimes ghosts who don’t acknowledge they are ghosts, sometimes “tourists” and sometimes just bodies. I do meet other people on the path but they never want to talk. I’m never sure if they are ghosts or “tourists”. If I go deeper in a crypt it turns into a house sometimes. Complete floor plan and all. Anyways, occasionally the ghosts would want some help with a little tasks, which I’m always happy to do. If I finish the task the dream is over. Well, as time went on I stopped getting asked to do tasks and I find myself climbing the hill, which is winding left and right- all the while crowded again with these crypts and tombstones. The last few times I have had the dream, I have reached the top of the hill where I am shocked to see a building. I go in and there is someone selling tickets to get in as well as a huge line of people waiting to get in. I cannot stress enough how this place is dark and gloomy and horrific at the bottom but when I leave the ticket booth, it’s a blue sky and real world. I have this dream a few times a year, and it may be coincidence that something big happens right after in my real life, but maybe not. I do have eerily accurate premonitions about things but I have no control over when they happen and when they don’t. For example, I knew the genders of my children before they were born, knew what my husband’s name would be, knew when my family pets were going to die, and so on. Anyways, I always thought it was a sort of astral projection but I have been going down the GATE rabbit hole and am honestly floored. As soon as I saw a map with “grave yard” on it I had this lurching in my stomach and my skin felt like static. I have a map I drew a long time ago in the garage somewhere and I will look for it and update when I find it.
